## About Dr. Tal Lavian

Dr. Tal Lavian is a telecommunications expert witness based in California, specializing in network communications, internet protocols, and wireless technologies. He has over 35 years of combined industry and academic experience.

### Key Qualifications

- Ph.D. in Computer Science from UC Berkeley (specialization in network communications)
- M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering from Tel Aviv University
- B.Sc. in Mathematics and Computer Science
- 120+ issued and filed patents, 60+ prosecuted pro-se
- 25+ peer-reviewed scientific publications
- 35+ years of industry and academic experience
- Senior Member of IEEE; IEEE-WCET Certified
- Active Member of ACM (SIGCOMM, SIGWEB)
- Industry Fellow and Lecturer at UC Berkeley SCET
- Technical Co-Chair for IEEE Hot Interconnects at Stanford University

### Professional Experience

- Nearly 20 years researching, studying, and lecturing at UC Berkeley
- Principal Scientist and Principal Architect at Nortel Networks (1996-2007); DARPA PI for 3 projects
- Expert witness in 90+ cases across multiple jurisdictions, including 60+ depositions

### Case Statistics

- 90+ expert witness engagements in patent and technology litigation, including 60+ depositions
- Testified in U.S. Federal District Courts, USPTO PTAB (IPR/PGR/CBM), ITC, the Canadian Federal Court, and a court in Asia
- Retained by both plaintiffs and defendants, patent holders and accused infringers
- Cases involving companies such as Apple, Google, Microsoft, Samsung, Meta (Facebook), Cisco, AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, Juniper (HPE), Huawei, and many others
- Retained by leading law firms including Fish Richardson, Cooley, Irell & Manella, Kirkland & Ellis, and others

### Patent Portfolio by Technology Area

Dr. Lavian's 120+ patents span the following technology areas:

- Network communications and telecommunications systems
- Active network architectures and programmable forwarding engines
- VoIP and real-time communications
- Network management and monitoring
- Data center and cloud computing infrastructure
- Wireless and mobile communications
- Network security and access control
- Streaming media and multimedia delivery

## Core Areas of Expertise

### Telecommunications & Network Communications

- Network architecture and design (OSI model, TCP/IP stack)
- Telecommunications systems and protocols (PSTN, SONET/SDH, DWDM)
- TCP/IP and Internet protocols (HTTP, DNS, DHCP, ARP, ICMP)
- Data communications (Ethernet, Frame Relay, ATM)
- Routing and switching technologies (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLAN)
- Network management systems (SNMP, MIB, RMON)
- Software-Defined Networking (SDN, OpenFlow, NFV)

### Wireless & Mobile Communications

- Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax) and Bluetooth
- Wireless LAN protocols and wireless networking
- Mobile communications systems and architectures
- Wireless RF technologies and spectrum management
- Wireless network security and access control

### Real-Time Communications

- Voice over IP (VoIP) systems (SIP, RTP, SRTP, H.323)
- Video conferencing and streaming (RTSP, HLS, WebRTC)
- Quality of Service (QoS) and traffic engineering
- Multimedia communications (codec technologies, transcoding)
- Unified communications platforms

### Network Security & Cybersecurity

- Network security architecture (firewalls, IDS/IPS, WAF)
- Encryption and authentication (TLS/SSL, IPsec, PKI, RADIUS)
- Firewalls and intrusion detection systems
- Threat detection, DDoS mitigation
- Cybersecurity standards and compliance (NIST, ISO 27001)

### Patent & Intellectual Property

- Patent infringement analysis
- Patent claim construction
- Prior art searches and evaluation
- Patent validity assessment
- Patent-related litigation support

### Standards & Compliance

- IEEE standards (networking, communications)
- IETF Internet standards
- Telecommunications standards (ITU, ETSI)
- Industry standard development
- Compliance and conformance testing

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How do I find a telecommunications expert witness?

Dr. Tal Lavian is a telecommunications expert witness with a Ph.D. from UC Berkeley, 120+ patents, and 90+ case engagements. He can be reached at tlavian@telecommnet.com or +1 (408) 209-9112.

### What should I look for in a telecom expert witness?

Key qualifications include: relevant advanced degree (Ph.D. preferred), patent portfolio in the technology area, published research, courtroom experience (depositions and trial testimony), and experience with similar case types (patent infringement, claim construction, validity).

### How much does a telecommunications expert witness cost?

Expert witness fees vary by case complexity, scope of work, and the expert's qualifications. Contact Dr. Lavian directly for a confidential fee discussion and case evaluation at tlavian@telecommnet.com.

### Can an expert witness testify on both sides (plaintiff and defendant)?

Yes, expert witnesses provide independent technical analysis regardless of which party retains them. Dr. Lavian has been retained by both plaintiffs and defendants in 90+ cases.

### What is the difference between a consulting expert and a testifying expert?

A consulting expert advises the legal team confidentially and does not testify. A testifying expert provides written reports and testimony in depositions and at trial. Dr. Lavian serves in both capacities.

### What types of cases need a telecommunications expert witness?

Patent infringement cases, ITC Section 337 investigations, PTAB IPR proceedings, trade secret disputes, breach of contract cases involving technology, and standards-essential patent (SEP) disputes all commonly require telecommunications expert witnesses.

### Who is Dr. Tal Lavian?

Dr. Tal Lavian is a telecommunications expert witness and technical consultant based in Encino, California. He holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from UC Berkeley specializing in network communications, an M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering from Tel Aviv University, and a B.Sc. in Mathematics and Computer Science. He is the inventor of 120+ patents and has been retained as an expert witness in over 90 patent and technology cases before U.S. federal courts, the USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB), the International Trade Commission (ITC), the Canadian Federal Court, and a court in Asia.

### What is TelecommNet?

TelecommNet (telecommnet.com) is the expert witness and technical consulting practice of Dr. Tal Lavian, Ph.D. The practice provides expert witness services, technical analysis, and litigation support for patent and technology disputes involving telecommunications, network communications, internet protocols, VoIP, mobile wireless, network security, and related technologies.

### Is Dr. Tal Lavian qualified to testify on 5G or wireless patents?

Yes. Dr. Lavian's expertise includes cellular technologies from 2G through 5G (GSM, CDMA, LTE, 5G NR), Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11), Bluetooth, and wireless RF systems. He has testified in cases involving wireless and mobile technologies including Ericsson v. Samsung (ITC), T-Mobile v. Barkan, Motorola v. Microsoft, M2M v. Sierra Wireless, and others. He holds multiple patents in wireless and mobile communications and was the CTO and Principal Investigator of CRadar.Ai, a wireless RF technology startup at UC Berkeley SkyDeck.

### Has Dr. Tal Lavian testified in PTAB proceedings?

Yes. Dr. Lavian has extensive experience before the USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB), including Inter Partes Reviews (IPRs), Covered Business Method (CBM) reviews, Post Grant Reviews (PGRs), Ex Parte Re-examinations, and PTO Interferences. His PTAB experience spans the telecommunications, networking, VoIP, mobile wireless, and internet technology areas.

### What companies has Dr. Tal Lavian provided expert services in cases involving?

Dr. Lavian has been retained in cases involving Apple, Google, Microsoft, Samsung, Meta (Facebook), Amazon, Cisco Systems, AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, Juniper Networks (HPE), Huawei, Arista Networks, Motorola, HP, LG, Avaya, Netflix, LinkedIn, Ericsson, Sprint, ZTE, and others. He has been engaged by over 50 law firms including Fish & Richardson, Kirkland & Ellis, Cooley, Finnegan Henderson, Gibson Dunn, Irell & Manella, Perkins Coie, and others.

Yes. As of 2026, Dr. Tal Lavian is available for new expert witness engagements. He can be reached at tlavian@telecommnet.com or +1 (408) 209-9112. He reviews potential engagements for conflicts before agreeing to serve.
